name: F.E.A.R. Extraction Point
description: F.E.A.R. Extraction Point is a singleplayer first-person shooter and horror expansion for F.E.A.R.

steam.patches: The English version loses some radio voices when hardware sound is on, and the unofficial 'F.E.A.R. Extraction Point EAX Fix' brings them back (per PCGamingWiki).

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in F.E.A.R. Extraction Point's configuration.
